# Test fixtures

- `sample-5k.gpx`, `sample-5k.tcx`, `rival-5k.gpx` are generated by
  `scripts/generate-samples.mjs` (synthetic loop around GBK Senayan, Jakarta).
- `sample-run.fit` is a 5.38 km running activity from
  [jimmykane/fit-parser](https://github.com/jimmykane/fit-parser)
  (`test/running-with-developer-data.fit`, MIT-licensed test data). It is used
  only to verify FIT decoding against a real Garmin file.
